chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The fighter in the way of Allāh who gets martyred would not get a greater reward than he who remains chaste despite means. It is possible that a chaste person may become one of the angels.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a chaste person compared to a martyr?
ai.summary: In this narration from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the status of *al-'iffah* (chastity/self-restraint) by comparing it to martyrdom, noting that while martyrdom is a supreme virtue, the one who possesses the means for marriage yet exercises self-control attains a spiritual purity akin to the angels. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on internal discipline and the preservation of one's spiritual state through active restraint, rather than merely the absence of sin. The comparison underscores that the difficulty of resisting desire when capable of fulfilling it grants a unique, angelic-like status to the chaste individual.
